_about: Every shipped code line naming a PowerShell program is fingerprinted. Direct launches require the exact user-terminal entry or one of the three reviewed security reads authorized by MAIN POWERSHELL GUARD RULING r2 (2026-11-11). reviewed_security pins each real launch by holder, call and full-source digests, with callsite, reason and citations; these are never names_only. The command-environment probe in engine-env.ts uses execCli, a fixed nonce-tagged script, a pinned NoProfile form, closed stdin, a hidden console, bounded output and bounded cleanup. No command text or environment value is interpolated into that script.
